units.translation: 269. 272. 273; dochmiacs 255f. (? pure or mixed with cretics, see below). 258f. 263. 265. 270f.? 274 f.; dochmiacs with cretics (which did not occur there in this way) 266. 268; finally iambs similar to those there: ◡ — ◡ —, ◡ — (257, see below) 262. Thus nothing falls outside the rest by being set only once, cf. on ⟦1⟧ p. 167. The introductory trimeters 244–253 are distinguished by particularly mimetic structure and sound. Corresponding to the rapid course, 244 is already only iambs, without the first foot; but then 246f.: ⟦2⟧ (three feet not interrupted by any word-end, thus especially fluid) ⟦3⟧ | ⟦4⟧, without spondee, after Dindorf, in accordance with Aeschylus's usage (on ⟦5⟧), restored -⟦6⟧ for -⟦7⟧. The striking hendiadys ⟦8⟧ instead of ⟦9⟧ can likewise be explained by this: -⟦10⟧- would be a harsh and flow-impeding clash of consonants, cf. what Dionysius ⟦11⟧. ⟦12⟧. p. 155ff. expounds about hard and soft composition with regard to the meeting of sounds. Then 248f., corresponding to the content, form the full contrast: ⟦13⟧ | ⟦14⟧· ⟦15⟧. One may not, because of Porson's law, want to write -⟦16⟧ (otherwise there would be spondees in all odd positions), but the consonants pile up as much as is at all possible in Greek: ⟦17⟧ contains 13 for only 5 vowels. But over the sea it went unhindered: ⟦18⟧ (Dindorf instead of ⟦19⟧., since ⟦20⟧ is the tragedians' form); also again ⟦21⟧.
for as a dog [tracks] a fawn
we track by blood and dripping
with many man-slaying toils he pants
for every place of the earth is pastured
over the sea with wingless flights
in no way behind a ship

244 ⟦1⟧ (asper over the 2nd syllable in M) ⟦2⟧. 719, otherwise not in Aeschylus. Suitable for the arrivals, who now stop for a moment and look around. They go by the scent of blood; but one need not dwell with the scholiast on the fact that Orestes' hands are still dripping with his mother's blood, which is supposedly utterly impossible. Also ⟦3⟧ 247 arises from the image of the fawn. ⟦4⟧ of blood is a similar oxymoron to ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧ of dust; cf. Wecklein on ⟦7⟧. ⟦8⟧ 247 "according to, after", like ⟦9⟧ ⟦10⟧.
